svg.title: Integrated Watchtower layout proposals
svg.desc: Ground and deck reservations for a compact 11 by 13 by 14 tower and a broader 17 by 15 by 14 gatehouse lookout. Both decks are five blocks above the lower guard bay. Diagrams are design proposals, not tested Minecraft templates.
svg.text: Two layouts · two initial guard cells · one five-block rise to the watch deck
S1–5 climb north; landings stay two blocks wide.
A: anchor / first guard · B: second guard · T: workbench
S1–3 south → landing at feet Y=4 → S4–5 north.
A: anchor / first guard · B: second guard · T: workbench
Five-block rise; hatched area is the open stairwell.
A/B: north-facing duties directly above the lower bay.
Five-block rise; hatched area is the open stairwell.
A/B: north-facing duties directly above the lower bay.
Roof profiles, wall openings, rail heights, and furnishings are defined in the accompanying design brief.
